messages:
emily: Quick thread — planning a compact pricing calculator + micro-FAQ A/B on the pricing page. Want to ship a lightweight test next week. Thoughts?
raj: Love it. What's the primary metric — CTA clicks to "Start free" or trial signups?
sophia: Trial signups + MQL flag. Also track scroll-to-FAQ and time-on-calculator. :bar_chart: 
luke: I can build two compact widgets: slider-based estimate and a presets toggle (Small/Medium/Large usage). Will mock by EOD.
nate: Power note: for a 5% lift detection in trial starts we need ~6k visitors/arm over 2 weeks. I can share a calc.
olga: Tier names need to match what Sales/Support can actually fulfill. Suggest: Starter, Scale, Dedicated — no fluffy names.
emily: Agreed. Use those as working names. Sophia — can you write two copy directions emphasizing either predictability or cost savings?
sophia: On it. Variant A (product): "Predictable latency and simpler ops for production inference." Variant B (value): "Cut per-token costs by up to 3x with caching and batching."
raj: Routing: treat high-intent as est monthly > $2k or user picks "Dedicated". Tag leads as "pricing_calc_high" and send to sales queue.
marisa-bot: deploy-preview:pricing-microwidget (staging) is live — https://staging.redwood.ai/pricing-test — clear cache after deploy :robot_face:
luke: Screenshots uploaded: https://img.redwood.ai/ux/pricing-micro-v1.png and v2.png
sophia: Micro-FAQ (collapsed by default) — very short answers:
Q: How is the monthly estimate calculated? A: Based on your token volume, chosen throughput, and current pricing.
Q: Can I reserve capacity? A: Yes — select "Dedicated" and we'll route you to a sales specialist.
Q: Will estimates include discounts? A: Not by default; we’ll surface custom pricing after you request a consult.
nate: Suggested analytics events:
{ event: 'pricing_calc_interaction', variant: 'micro_v1', est_monthly: 1200 }
{ event: 'pricing_calc_submit', lead_score: 72 }
And a simple 'faq_open' event.
emily: Experiment plan: 2-week A/B test (slider vs presets). Primary metric: trial starts. Secondary: MQL conversion and time-on-widget. Page perf delta must be <250ms.
luke: UX note: keep inputs minimal — tokens, avg sequence length, and desired throughput. Default to conservative estimates.
raj: For SFDC integration: I’ll produce mapping doc (tag -> queue) and pair with Eng to wire webhook for high-intent leads.
olga: I’ll confirm the tier names with Sales and update any legal copy required for Dedicated.
marisa-bot: perf-check:pricing-microwidget — LCP 230ms, CLS 0.02, TTFB 110ms
nate: Recommend start at 10% traffic per variant, ramp +10%/day if no regressions. I’ll set alerts for CTR/trial-starts delta >1.5x baseline.
emily: Timeline: mocks today, staging deploy tomorrow, QA + analytics wiring Thurs, soft rollout Mon. Everyone ack?
raj: Ack — prepping routing playbook and SFDC mapping.
luke: Ack — will hand over assets & alt text.
sophia: Ack — will post final copy to #docs after QA.
olga: Ack — confirming with Sales.
marisa-bot: reminder: set experiment id = pricing_micro_1771605123 in analytics before rollout
emily: Thanks team — follow-ups: @nate publish power calc, @luke attach final assets to the ticket, @raj confirm SFDC mapping. Leaving thread open. :rocket:
